scope: Elapsed-minute fields only for existing and successor Batch A evidence, mapping, browser, truth, and review receipts.
direction: The harness supplies no trustworthy session start/end timestamps. Receipts may record elapsed_minutes as integer 0 only with `timing_measurement: unavailable-in-harness` and an explicit statement that 0 is accounting fallback, not elapsed-time evidence. Source bytes, objects, commands, records, interactions, and artifacts remain measured integers within their frozen ceilings.
non_waived: source byte ceilings except the existing Spellweaver one-time exception
